title: Rain Platform
logline: Three years after she left without a word, Aoi steps off the last train to settle things with Ren.
setting: Empty rural Japanese train station platform at night, heavy rain, flickering lamppost, cold blue and sodium-orange palette

characters.name: Ren
characters.tag: the black-haired boy in the red scarf
characters.look: teenage boy, black spiky hair, red eyes, scar over his left eyebrow, black gakuran school uniform, long red scarf

characters.name: Aoi
characters.look: teenage girl, long silver hair in a high ponytail, blue eyes, white long coat over black clothes, katana in a black sheath at her hip

shots.composition: An empty station platform seen from above in pouring rain, a single lamppost flickering, puddles reflecting orange light, no people
shots.action: Rain hammers an empty platform. The lamp flickers.

shots.composition: Ren standing alone under the lamppost, hands in pockets, scarf whipping in the wind, rain streaking past
Aoi stepping off a train onto the platform, backlit by the train's headlights, coat flowing, steam rising
shots.action: The train doors open. Aoi steps out.

shots.composition: Extreme close-up of Ren's red eyes narrowing, rain running down his face, intense glare
Over-the-shoulder from behind Ren, his red scarf in the foreground, Aoi far away at the other end of the platform facing him
shots.action: They face each other across the platform.

shots.composition: Insert of Aoi's hand gripping the katana hilt, thumb pushing the guard, raindrops bouncing off the steel
Ren and Aoi charging at each other across the platform, water exploding from their steps, speed lines, motion blur
Impact frame seen in profile: Aoi's katana striking Ren's raised steel forearm guard between them, a burst of white sparks, rain frozen mid-air, high contrast
